description: Search ~19,000 DeFi yield pools across all chains: filter by chain, protocol, token, stablecoin-only, min TVL; sort by APY or TVL. Base vs reward APY, 30 d mean, IL risk. DefiLlama yields data, refreshed every 15 minutes. Shows APY split into base (organic fees/interest) and reward (token emissions), the 30-day mean APY so an agent can spot unsustainable spikes, impermanent-loss risk, exposure (single/multi) and DefiLlama's up/down prediction. Price: $0.003 per call (10 free/day; after that a payment-required result lists x402 options). Errors: returns isError with a message for invalid input or an upstream failure (not charged).

limit.description: How many pools to return. Range 1-50. Default 20.

max_apy.description: drop absurd APYs above this. Default 1000.

min_tvl_usd.description: Skip pools with less TVL than this (USD); raises quality. Default 1000000.

project.description: protocol slug, e.g. aave-v3, kamino-lend, uniswap-v3

single_exposure_only.description: no LP pairs (no impermanent loss) Default false.

sort.description: Rank by total APY, TVL, base (non-reward) APY or 30-day mean APY. One of "apy", "tvl", "apy_base", "apy_30d_mean". Default "apy".

stablecoin_only.description: true = only pools whose assets are all stablecoins. Default false.

token.description: token symbol that must appear in the pool, e.g. USDC, SOL

name: yield_pools
title: DeFi yield finder
